Building a DIY Water Filter System for Stray Cats Our stray cats were drinking from a filthy ditch - full of bugs and stagnant rainwater. So we built them a natural, multi-stage water filtration system using clay pots, volcanic rock, sponges, and a solar-powered pump! With aquatic plants, a mini fish pond, and a cozy shaded pavilion, the place transformed into a peaceful oasis where our rescue cats can safely hydrate, play, and nap.
